aurora-android-thin.description: Android thin WebView capability. Grants only nonsecret thin profile storage, opaque peer reconnect proof commands, narrow Android Keystore inbound verifier storage, native Android status, mobile mesh/deep-link, and core UI primitives; no sidecar, generic secure storage, local files, audio bridge, shell/process, or raw credential getter.

aurora-desktop-updater.description: Desktop-only Aurora signed updater capability. Kept outside the shared shell capability so iOS builds do not validate the desktop-only updater plugin permission.

aurora-ios-baseline.description: IOS-001 baseline capability for the Tauri iOS shell. Grants the Aurora bridge and native manifest commands but omits desktop-only updater permissions.

aurora-ios-thin.description: iOS thin WebView capability. Grants only nonsecret thin profile storage, opaque Keychain reconnect-proof commands, dedicated inbound verifier storage, bounded iOS native status, mobile mesh/deep-link, and core UI primitives; no sidecar, generic secure storage, local files, audio bridge, shell/process, or raw credential getter.

aurora-main.description: Main Aurora shell capability. Grants only the TAURI-004 SDK bridge, native manifest, sidecar health, log-tail status, explicit denied native helper commands, shutdown, and minimal window/app/event primitives.

aurora-mobile-mesh.description: Mobile-only mesh onboarding and bounded outgoing action capability: QR scanning for mesh invites, aurora:// deep-link events, sharing, safe link opening, and notifications.

aurora-overlay.description: Constrained Aurora overlay capability for the dedicated overlay window. Grants only overlay controls, the Aurora SDK bridge, and minimal app/event/window primitives.

aurora-thin.description: Python-free desktop thin shell capability. Grants native shell status/storage helpers only; no sidecar lifecycle, local SDK request bridge, Python resources, or local service bootstrap permissions.
